The project showcases skills in R programming, reproducible data analysis, data visualization, web-based data collection, Census API techniques, and Git/GitHub version control.

## PA 446 Project: Coding for Civic Data Applications
This project was completed as part of PA 446: Coding for Civic Data Applications. The project incorporated multiple approaches to obtaining, analyzing, and presenting civic data, including working with APIs, web scraping, data manipulation, and visualization in R.
The project showcases skills in R programming, reproducible data analysis, data visualization, web-based data collection, Census API techniques, and Git/GitHub version control.
